title: Make Feature Constellation nodes reachable without a pointer
body:
## Summary
The constellation svg is role=img, which flattens every node's <title>, and its nodes are hover-only, so keyboard and screen-reader users get neither the per-feature status nor the prerequisite-chain highlight.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/index.tsx:148 declares role="img" on an svg whose nodes carry information (status, blocker) in <title> (src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/ConstellationNodeG.tsx:281); the lit chain is driven by onHoverStart/onHoverEnd only (ConstellationNodeG.tsx:277). canvas-graph/canvas-accessibility: pick the role from whether the contents are operable, and every operation has a keyboard path. Fixed looks like the Nexus map tonight (63fd5e82): role=group named with counts, one roving tab stop, focus drives the same litKeys as hover.

## Flow
- Tab into the Constellation tab -> focus skips the svg entirely
- Screen reader announces 'Feature constellation for Character' and nothing inside
- Fix: role=group + aria-label with feature/blocked counts; roving tabIndex on ConstellationNodeG; onFocus/onBlur -> setHoveredKey; arrow keys rove

## Expected impact
Keyboard and AT users can read each feature's status and walk its prerequisite chain; measured by a keyboard test like NexusGraph.keyboard.test.tsx. Could break: motion.g focus styling.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - constellation nodes keyboard- and AT-reachable
Before: 0 focusable nodes; svg role=img (children hidden from AT)
After: 1 tab stop, N roving nodes with aria-label (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked the render path; the round spent its build budget on 11 Lane A items
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/index.tsx:148 role="img"
src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/ConstellationNodeG.tsx:277-279 onHoverStart/onHoverEnd, cursor default, no tabIndex

title: Extract the duplicated edge geometry and guard coincident node centres
body:
## Summary
GraphCanvas and NexusGraph each hand-compute the same shortened quadratic edge path; neither guards dist=0, which yields NaN path data.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/DependencyGraph/GraphCanvas.tsx:69-84 and src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/NexusGraph.tsx:68-80 are the same derivation (unit vector, NODE_W/2+4 and +10 trims, 20px perpendicular bow). dist=0 (two modules at one centre, or a self-edge) gives ux=uy=NaN and an invalid d. One pure edgePath(from, to, nodeW, nodeH) in src/lib/topology/moduleGraph.ts (owned by blueprint-tools) would be the single derivation both call, with a dist=0 guard.

## Flow
- Two nodes share cx/cy -> dx=dy=0 -> 0/0
- path d='MNaN,NaN Q...' -> the browser drops the edge silently
- Fix: edgePath() in moduleGraph.ts with a near-zero fallback; both canvases call it

## Expected impact
One geometry rule instead of two; NaN edges become impossible. Could break: pixel positions if the extraction drifts (pin 3 edges).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one edge-geometry derivation, NaN-safe
Before: 2 copies of the derivation; dist=0 -> NaN path
After: 1 copy; dist=0 -> finite path (predicted)
Method: simulation - the helper's home is src/lib/topology (blueprint-tools context), out of this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/evaluator/DependencyGraph/GraphCanvas.tsx:71-73 const dist = Math.sqrt(...); const ux = dx / dist;
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/NexusGraph.tsx:70-72 identical
instrument: unit test of edgePath on 3 edges (incl. coincident centres) + both canvases render identical d for the same input

title: Make the Nexus Pattern-success legend show the three heat colours it draws
body:
## Summary
The legend shows one green swatch for Pattern success while the node heat bar is green/amber/red by threshold, so amber and red bars have no legend entry.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/NexusGraph.tsx colours the heat bar STATUS_SUCCESS >=0.7, STATUS_WARNING >=0.4, else STATUS_ERROR; src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/index.tsx renders a single STATUS_SUCCESS swatch labelled 'Pattern success'. A red bar reads as blocked (the only other red on the map) rather than low pattern success.

## Flow
- Enable the Pattern Success layer with a module at 0.3 -> red left bar
- Legend offers only green 'Pattern success'
- Fix: three swatches with thresholds (>=70% / 40-69% / <40%), thresholds from one constant shared with NexusGraph

## Expected impact
Users can decode amber and red heat bars; measured by legend entries = distinct heat colours. Could break: nothing functional.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - legend covers every heat colour drawn
Before: 1 legend swatch for 3 drawn colours
After: 3 swatches for 3 colours (predicted)
Method: simulation - read both sites
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test: patterns layer on -> legend swatch count equals distinct heat colours (3)

title: Say how many Nexus deep-dive patterns are hidden behind the top 5
body:
## Summary
Matching Patterns shows a count of all patterns but lists only the first five, with no 'and N more'.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/NodeDeepDivePanel.tsx passes count={patterns.length} to the section and renders patterns.slice(0, 5). With 12 patterns the badge says 12 and 5 rows appear; the other 7 are unreachable and unannounced.

## Flow
- Select a module with 12 patterns -> badge 12, 5 rows
- Fix: '+7 more' row (or a link to the Pattern Library filtered to the module)

## Expected impact
The count and the list agree; measured by a render test with 7 patterns. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - truncation is disclosed
Before: badge 12, rows 5, 0 disclosure
After: badge 12, rows 5, '+7 more' (predicted)
Method: simulation - read the component
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render NodeDeepDivePanel with 7 patterns; assert '+2 more' text

title: Point the Nexus deep-dive's default open section at one that exists
body:
## Summary
NodeDeepDivePanel opens 'checklist' by default, an id no section uses, so the panel always opens fully collapsed.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/NodeDeepDivePanel.tsx:40 useState('checklist'); the four CollapsibleSection ids are 'patterns', 'recs', 'sessions', 'genre' (grep: 0 sections use 'checklist'). Either default to the first non-empty section (recs when critical findings exist) or to null, deliberately.

## Flow
- Click a module -> the deep-dive opens with every section collapsed
- Fix: default to the first present section id, or null with a comment

## Expected impact
The intent (open something on arrival) is restored or removed honestly. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no dead default
Before: default id matches 0 of 4 sections
After: matches 1 of 4 (or null by intent)
Method: probe - grep of the section ids in the file
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test: first present section reports aria-expanded=true on mount (aria-expanded landed in 3e98d5f7)

title: Disclose the overlap heatmap's 12-module cap
body:
## Summary
The 'Modules by Overlap Count' heatmap renders moduleSummaries.slice(0, 12) with no sign that more modules overlap.

## Description

## Flow

## Evaluation
Claim: user - truncation disclosed
Before: 15 summaries -> 12 bubbles, 0 disclosure
After: 12 bubbles + '+3 more'
Method: simulation - read the component
Result: better

title: Clear the overlap Copied-feedback timer on unmount
body:
## Summary
handleCopy schedules setCopiedId(null) with a bare setTimeout that is never cleared, so leaving the Conflicts tab inside the feedback window sets state on an unmounted panel.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/CrossModuleOverlapPanel/index.tsx handleCopy: setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), UI_TIMEOUTS.copyFeedback) with no handle kept and no cleanup effect.

## Flow
- Copy an overlap -> switch tab within copyFeedback ms -> the timer fires against an unmounted component
- Fix: keep the handle in a ref and clear it in an unmount effect

## Expected impact
No stray timer after navigation; measured with fake timers + unmount. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - no timer outlives the panel
Before: 1 uncleared timer per copy
After: 0
Method: simulation - read handleCopy
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest fake timers: copy, unmount, advance timers, assert clearTimeout called / no setState after unmount

title: Announce the Constellation and Conflicts loading spinners
body:
## Summary FeatureConstellation and CrossModuleOverlapPanel render a bare spinning icon on load with no role=status or text, unlike DependencyGraph and (since tonight) Nexus. ## Description src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/index.tsx:64-69 and the CrossModuleOverlapPanel/index.tsx loading branch render
: no live region, no label. DependencyGraph/index.tsx and NexusView/index.tsx use role=status aria-live=polite + 'Loading feature statuses…'. Two of four sibling views announce loading. ## Flow - Open the Conflicts tab with a screen reader -> silence until the panel appears - Fix: the same role=status + text wrapper (or the shared LoadingRow primitive) ## Expected impact AT users hear the load; measured by getByRole('status') in both views. Could break: nothing. ## Evaluation Claim: user - loading state announced Before: 2 of 4 topology views announce loading After: 4 of 4 Method: probe - read all four loading branches Result: better Gate: none
instrument: getByRole('status') render test for both views on first load

title: Route the raw hex-alpha suffixes through statusBg/statusBorder
body:
## Summary
Seven sites build translucent colours by appending a two-digit alpha to a colour string instead of the chart-colors helpers, and the pattern yields invalid CSS when handed a var().

## Description
OverlapRow.tsx (3 badges, `${x}18`), SummaryParts.tsx FilterChip (`${color}18`, `${color}40`) and NodeDeepDivePanel.tsx (recommendation badge and CollapsibleSection, `${c}15`) all under src/components/modules/evaluator/. Tonight's FilterChip All bug (05f8e645) was exactly this pattern fed a var(). statusBg/statusBorder in src/lib/chart-colors.ts are the house helpers; the no-hex guard added tonight could also forbid a template ending in two hex digits.

## Flow
- grep the four folders for templates ending in }18 / }40 / }15 -> 7 hits
- Fix: statusBg(color, 0.08) / statusBorder(color, 0.20); extend module-topology-graph-no-hex.test.ts with a seeded raw-suffix matcher

## Expected impact
One opacity vocabulary; a var() colour can no longer yield invalid CSS unseen. Could break: alpha shifts slightly (0x18 = 9.4% vs 8%).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one opacity vocabulary
Before: 7 raw suffix sites
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: probe - grep count over the four folders
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: extend src/__tests__/components/evaluator/module-topology-graph-no-hex.test.ts with a raw-alpha-suffix matcher (seeded red), then fix to green

title: Give the Nexus layer toggles and Constellation refresh a visible focus ring
body:
## Summary
Nexus's four layer toggles (and their Retry buttons) and the Constellation Refresh button carry no focus-ring class, so keyboard focus is invisible on them.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/index.tsx LayerToggle buttons (border/bg classes only) and src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/index.tsx Refresh button: no focus-ring or focus-visible class. Sibling controls (GraphControls, tonight's Nexus zoom buttons) use the shared .focus-ring token.

## Flow
- Tab through the Nexus header -> focus disappears on the 4 layer toggles
- Fix: add focus-ring to each

## Expected impact
Visible focus on 6 controls (WCAG 2.4.7). Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - focus visible
Before: 6 controls without a focus indicator
After: 0
Method: probe - read the class lists
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/evaluator/NexusView/index.tsx LayerToggle className lacks focus-ring
src/components/modules/evaluator/FeatureConstellation/index.tsx Refresh button className="p-1.5 rounded-md ..." lacks focus-ring
instrument: source guard: every <button in the four folders carries focus-ring|focus-visible (seeded with one offender)
